# Fetching Sources: Where We Get External Data

Catalogue of every external source we can fetch from, how to fetch it, what goes wrong, and the order to do it in.

- **Purpose:** enrich the provided BMW data ([`../02-data/README.md`](../02-data/README.md)) with competitor, market and customer signals from the web.
- **Vehicles in scope:** 1 Series (F70), 5 Series (G60 / G68), 7 Series (G70). No other BMW series.
- **Markets in scope:** USA, China, Europe (including the UK). Platforms shared across markets (Reddit, YouTube, app stores and similar) are in scope too and are split by market after fetching. Other markets are parked in [section 8](#8-sources-to-skip).
- **Status:** source list only. Bias and importance weighting per source are **not decided yet** (see [section 9](#9-open-points)).
- **Verify before coding:** API limits, URLs and terms of use below are from general knowledge, not checked live. Confirm each one when you build its fetcher.

## Contents

1. [Categories at a glance](#1-categories-at-a-glance)
2. [What to search for](#2-what-to-search-for)
3. [Sources by category](#3-sources-by-category)
4. [Sources by market](#4-sources-by-market) (shared platforms, USA, China, Europe)
5. [Record format for everything we fetch](#5-record-format-for-everything-we-fetch)
6. [Problems that will occur](#6-problems-that-will-occur)
7. [Recommended fetching order](#7-recommended-fetching-order)
8. [Sources to skip](#8-sources-to-skip)
9. [Open points](#9-open-points)

---

## 1. Categories at a glance

| ID | Category | Question it answers | Feeds which PM argument |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | Owner complaints and defects | What does not work? | Customer complaint |
| **B** | Owner reviews and ratings | What do owners like, dislike, miss? | Customer complaint, customer wish |
| **C** | Community discussion | What do people wish for, why do they switch brand? | Customer wish |
| **D** | Expert and video reviews | How does the car compare in a test? | Competition |
| **E** | Competitor releases and equipment | What do rivals offer that we do not? | Competition |
| **F** | Market and sales trends | Which models, powertrains, segments are growing? | Market relevance |
| **G** | Quality and satisfaction studies | How do independent rankings place us? | Evidence level |
| **H** | Digital services and apps | What fails in the app and connected services? | Customer complaint |
| **I** | Future trends | What will matter in 3 to 5 years? | Future-facing assumptions |

Difficulty scale used below: **Easy** = official API or RSS. **Medium** = plain HTML scraping. **Hard** = anti-bot protection, login, paywall or non-English.

---

## 2. What to search for

Fetch every source with the same model list, so results are comparable.

| BMW model | Predecessor (for regression check) | Core competitors | Chinese competitors |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Series **F70** | F40 | Audi A3, Mercedes A-Class, VW Golf, Cupra Leon | MG4, BYD Dolphin |
| 5 Series **G60 / G68**, i5 | G30 | Mercedes E-Class / EQE, Audi A6 / A6 e-tron, Tesla Model S, Genesis G80, Lexus ES | NIO ET7, Zeekr 001, Xiaomi SU7, BYD Han |
| 7 Series **G70**, i7 | G11 / G12 | Mercedes S-Class / EQS, Audi A8, Lexus LS, Genesis G90, Porsche Panamera, Lucid Air | NIO ET9, Maextro S800, Hongqi H9 |

Which model to fetch in which market (from the sales volumes file):

| Model | USA | China | Europe |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Series F70 | Not sold, skip | Not sold, skip | **Yes** |
| 5 Series G60 / i5 | **Yes** | Sold as long-wheelbase **G68** | **Yes** |
| 7 Series G70 / i7 | **Yes** | **Yes** | **Yes** |

That gives 7 model-market combinations. Fetch competitors only in the markets where the matching BMW is sold.

Search terms per model: model name, chassis code, model year, and the electric name (`"5 Series"`, `G60`, `i5`, `2024 530i`). Keep this table as one config file so adding a vehicle or market needs no code change.

---

## 3. Sources by category

### A. Owner complaints and defects

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NHTSA complaints | US | `api.nhtsa.gov/complaints/complaintsByVehicle` | Dated owner complaints by make, model, year, component | Free public API, no key | Easy |
| NHTSA recalls | US | `api.nhtsa.gov/recalls/recallsByVehicle` | Recall campaigns per model | Free public API | Easy |
| CarComplaints.com | US | `carcomplaints.com` | Complaints grouped by problem type and year | Scraping | Medium |
| Honest John "Good and Bad" | UK | `honestjohn.co.uk` | Known faults per model | Scraping | Medium |
| ADAC breakdown statistics | DE | `adac.de` | Breakdown rates per model | Published tables | Medium |
| TÜV Report | DE | `tuv.com`, press coverage | Inspection defect rates per model | Press summaries free, full report paid | Medium |
| 12365auto | CN | `12365auto.com` | Chinese owner complaint platform | Scraping, Chinese, anti-bot | Hard |

> Safety regulation is out of scope for the challenge. Use these for usability and quality complaints, and filter out pure safety-compliance items.

### B. Owner reviews and ratings

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Edmunds consumer reviews | US | `edmunds.com` | Star rating plus free text per model year | Scraping | Medium to Hard |
| Kelley Blue Book | US | `kbb.com` | Owner ratings by category | Scraping | Medium to Hard |
| Cars.com | US | `cars.com` | Owner reviews with category scores | Scraping | Medium |
| Parkers owner reviews | UK | `parkers.co.uk` | Owner reviews per model | Scraping | Medium |
| Auto Trader UK | UK | `autotrader.co.uk` | Owner reviews | Scraping | Hard |
| What Car? | UK | `whatcar.com` | Owner reviews, reliability survey | Scraping | Medium |
| Carwow | UK, DE | `carwow.co.uk` | Owner and expert reviews | Scraping | Medium |
| mobile.de / AutoScout24 | DE, EU | `mobile.de`, `autoscout24.de` | Owner ratings | Scraping | Hard |
| Caradisiac, Quattroruote, km77, AutoWeek.nl | FR, IT, ES, NL | respective sites | Owner reviews in the other large EU markets | Scraping, local language | Medium |
| Autohome | CN | `autohome.com.cn` | Largest Chinese owner review base (koubei) | Scraping, Chinese, anti-bot | Hard |
| Dongchedi | CN | `dongchedi.com` | Owner reviews and rankings | Scraping, Chinese, anti-bot | Hard |
| Yiche, PCauto, Xcar | CN | `yiche.com`, `pcauto.com.cn`, `xcar.com.cn` | Further Chinese owner review bases | Scraping, Chinese, anti-bot | Hard |

### C. Community discussion

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reddit | Global, US-heavy | `r/BMW`, `r/BMWi5`, `r/BMWi7`, `r/cars`, `r/electricvehicles`, `r/whatcarshouldIbuy`, `r/mercedes_benz`, `r/Audi`, `r/TeslaLounge`, `r/CarTalkUK` | Long threads, wishes, brand-switch reasons | Official API with OAuth | Easy |
| Bimmerpost | Global, US-heavy | `g60.bimmerpost.com`, `g70.bimmerpost.com`, F70 sub-forum | Most detailed BMW owner problem threads | Scraping (vBulletin) | Medium |
| Bimmerfest | US | `bimmerfest.com` | Owner threads | Scraping | Medium |
| MBWorld, AudiWorld, Tesla Motors Club, ClubLexus, Genesis Owners | US | respective forums | Same depth for competitors | Scraping | Medium |
| Motor-Talk | DE | `motor-talk.de` | Largest German car forum | Scraping, German | Medium |
| PistonHeads | UK | `pistonheads.com` | UK enthusiast threads | Scraping | Medium |
| SpeakEV | UK | `speakev.com` | EV owner threads (i5, i7, rivals) | Scraping | Medium |
| Facebook owner groups | Global | private groups | Active owner communities | Login required, not allowed | Skip |
| Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Douyin, Zhihu | CN | respective platforms | Chinese social opinion | Anti-bot, Chinese | Hard |

### D. Expert and video reviews

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube video transcripts | Global | Carwow, Doug DeMuro, Throttle House, Savagegeese, AutoTrader UK, Out of Spec Reviews, Autogefühl, Wheelsboy (Chinese cars) | Reviewer verdict as text | Transcript library (unofficial) | Medium |
| YouTube comments | Global | same channels | Thousands of viewer opinions per video | YouTube Data API v3 with key | Easy |
| Car and Driver, MotorTrend | US | `caranddriver.com`, `motortrend.com` | Tests, comparison tests, highs and lows | Scraping, RSS for new items | Medium |
| Autocar, Auto Express, Top Gear | UK | respective sites | Tests and verdict lists | Scraping, RSS | Medium |
| auto motor und sport, Auto Bild | DE | respective sites | German comparison tests | Scraping, German, partly paywalled | Medium to Hard |
| Podcasts | Global | The Smoking Tire, Autocar podcast | Long-form opinions | Audio transcription needed | Hard |

### E. Competitor releases and equipment

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| OEM press portals | Global | `media.mercedes-benz.com`, `audi-mediacenter.com`, `press.bmwgroup.com`, Tesla, Genesis, Lexus, Porsche newsroom | Official launch news, specs, feature lists | Web pages, some RSS | Easy to Medium |
| Chinese OEM sites | CN, Global | BYD, NIO, Xiaomi EV, Zeekr | Launches and feature announcements | Web pages, often JS-rendered | Medium |
| Competitor price and option lists | DE, UK, US | OEM sites, PDF downloads | Standard vs optional equipment, comparable to our option-list PDFs | PDF parsing | Medium |
| Online configurators | per market | OEM sites | Exact equipment per trim | JS apps, internal APIs | Hard |
| Car news feeds | Global | Motor1, InsideEVs, Electrek, Autoblog, The Drive, Carscoops | New models, facelifts, feature news | RSS | Easy |
| China car news in English | CN | `carnewschina.com`, `cnevpost.com` | Chinese launches, specs, monthly sales | RSS, scraping | Easy |
| Auto show coverage | Global | IAA Munich, Auto Shanghai, Auto Beijing, CES | Upcoming models, concept features | News articles | Easy |
| Euro NCAP, IIHS | EU, US | `euroncap.com`, `iihs.org` | Assistance-system ratings | Web pages | Medium, mostly out of scope |

### F. Market and sales trends

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KBA | DE | `kba.de` | New registrations by model, monthly | Excel/PDF downloads | Medium |
| SMMT | UK | `smmt.co.uk` | Registrations, best-seller lists | Press tables | Medium |
| ACEA | EU | `acea.auto` | Registrations by brand and powertrain | Press releases, PDF | Medium |
| CPCA / CAAM | CN | via `cnevpost.com`, `carnewschina.com` | Chinese sales by model | English summaries | Medium |
| GoodCarBadCar, CarFigures | US | respective sites | US sales by model | Scraping | Medium |
| Google Trends | Global | `trends.google.com` | Search interest per model or feature, by country | Unofficial library, rate limited | Medium |
| JATO, MarkLines, S&P Global Mobility | Global | respective sites | Professional market data | Paid, press releases free | Hard |

### G. Quality and satisfaction studies

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| J.D. Power (IQS, APEAL, TXI, VDS) | US, CN | `jdpower.com` | Brand and segment rankings, top problem areas | Press releases free, data paid | Medium |
| Consumer Reports | US | `consumerreports.org` | Reliability and owner satisfaction | Paywalled | Hard |
| What Car? Reliability Survey | UK | `whatcar.com` | Reliability by model | Articles free | Medium |
| ADAC Autotest | DE | `adac.de` | Scored tests by category | Web pages | Medium |
| Driver Power (Auto Express) | UK | `autoexpress.co.uk` | Owner satisfaction ranking | Articles free | Medium |

### H. Digital services and apps

| Source | Market | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Google Play reviews | per country | My BMW, Mercedes-Benz, myAudi, Tesla, Genesis apps | Dated, rated reviews of connected services | Scraper library | Easy |

| Reddit and forum software threads | Global | iDrive, CarPlay, OTA update threads | Infotainment and update problems | As in C | Easy to Medium |

### I. Future trends

| Source | Where | What you get | Access | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deloitte Global Automotive Consumer Study | `deloitte.com` | Consumer intentions by country | Free PDF | Medium |
| McKinsey Center for Future Mobility | `mckinsey.com` | Mobility consumer surveys | Free articles | Medium |
| Capgemini, PwC, EY mobility reports | respective sites | Trend forecasts | Free PDF | Medium |
| IEA Global EV Outlook | `iea.org` | EV adoption and charging forecasts | Free PDF and data | Medium |
| CES and auto show coverage | news sites | Technology direction | RSS | Easy |

---

## 4. Sources by market

Same sources as section 3, regrouped by where the customer lives: shared platforms first, then USA, China and Europe. Use this view when the PM picks a market. The feedback files are about 90% US for G60 and G70 and UK/Japan for F70, so Europe and China are where external data adds most.

### 4.1 Shared platforms (one fetch, several markets)

Fetch these once, then assign each record to a market with the rule in the last column. If no rule applies, store `market = unknown` and keep the record as global evidence.

| Platform | Markets it covers | Need | How to split by market |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reddit | USA strong, Europe partial, China none | Discussion, wishes | Subreddit (`r/CarTalkUK`, `r/de`), post language, country named in the text |
| YouTube comments and transcripts | USA, Europe; China only via English channels | Expert reviews, viewer opinion | Channel home country, video language (German channels for DE, Wheelsboy for Chinese cars) |
| Bimmerpost and competitor forums | USA strong, Europe partial | Detailed problems | Member location field where shown, regional sub-forums |
| Apple App Store reviews | USA, Europe, China | Digital services | One fetch per country storefront (`us`, `de`, `gb`, `fr`, `cn`) |
| Google Play reviews | USA, Europe; **not available in China** | Digital services | One fetch per country and language |
| Google Trends | USA, Europe; **not usable for China** | Search interest | Country parameter |
| OEM press portals | All three | Competitor releases | Regional press site or market named in the release |
| Car news RSS | All three | Competitor releases | Site region, market named in the article |
| J.D. Power press releases | USA and China (separate studies) | Studies | Study name |
| Carwow | UK and Germany | Owner and expert reviews | Site domain |
| Consulting reports (Deloitte, McKinsey) | All three, reported per country | Future trends | Country tables inside the report |

### 4.2 USA

| Need | Sources | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|
| Complaints and defects | NHTSA complaints and recalls API, CarComplaints.com | Easy to Medium |
| Owner reviews | Edmunds, Kelley Blue Book, Cars.com, CarGurus | Medium to Hard |
| Forums | Bimmerpost, Bimmerfest, MBWorld, AudiWorld, Tesla Motors Club, ClubLexus, Genesis Owners, Lucid Owners | Medium |
| Expert reviews | Car and Driver, MotorTrend, Edmunds expert reviews, Doug DeMuro, Savagegeese, Out of Spec Reviews | Medium |
| Studies | J.D. Power (IQS, APEAL, TXI), Consumer Reports, IIHS | Medium to Hard |
| Sales | GoodCarBadCar, CarFigures, Cox Automotive / Kelley Blue Book sales reports | Medium |
| Equipment | US OEM sites and "build and price" pages (US trims differ from the German option lists) | Medium to Hard |

### 4.3 China

| Need | Sources | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|
| Owner reviews | Autohome (`autohome.com.cn`), Dongchedi (`dongchedi.com`), Yiche (`yiche.com`), PCauto (`pcauto.com.cn`), Xcar (`xcar.com.cn`) | Hard |
| Complaints and defects | 12365auto (`12365auto.com`, owner complaint platform), SAMR recall notices | Hard |
| Social and video | Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Douyin, Zhihu | Hard |
| Search interest | Baidu Index (China replacement for Google Trends) | Hard, login |
| Sales | CPCA, CAAM (use the English summaries below) | Medium |
| Studies | J.D. Power China (press releases) | Medium |
| **English-language proxies** | CarNewsChina, CnEVPost, Wheelsboy and Inside China Auto on YouTube | Easy |

> All native Chinese platforms need Chinese-language handling and have strong anti-bot protection; several need a Chinese phone number to log in. For the hackathon, the English proxies are the realistic route. Remember China uses the long-wheelbase G68, not the G60.

### 4.4 Europe

| Country | Complaints and reliability | Owner reviews and forums | Expert reviews | Sales |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Germany** | ADAC breakdown statistics, TÜV Report | Motor-Talk, mobile.de, AutoScout24 | auto motor und sport, Auto Bild, ADAC Autotest, Autogefühl | KBA |
| **UK** | Honest John, What Car? Reliability Survey, Driver Power | Parkers, Auto Trader, Carwow, PistonHeads, SpeakEV, r/CarTalkUK | Autocar, Auto Express, Top Gear, What Car? | SMMT |
| **France** | | Caradisiac (owner "avis"), L'argus | L'Automobile Magazine, Caradisiac | PFA / CCFA |
| **Italy** | | Quattroruote, AlVolante | Quattroruote | UNRAE |
| **Spain** | | km77, coches.net | km77 | ANFAC |
| **Netherlands** | | AutoWeek.nl owner reviews | AutoWeek | RAI / BOVAG |
| **Nordics** | | Elbilforum (Norway, EV owners) | Teknikens Värld (Sweden) | OFV (Norway), Mobility Sweden |
| **EU-wide** | EU Safety Gate, Euro NCAP | | | ACEA |

Difficulty: mostly Medium (plain scraping), with language handling per country. Germany and the UK cover the bulk of European volume and are enough for a first pass.

### 4.5 Market coverage check

| Market | Models | Easy sources available | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| USA | G60, G70 | Many (NHTSA, Reddit, forums, app stores) | None; already dominant in the provided feedback |
| Europe: UK | F70, G60, G70 | Several (Parkers, Honest John, app stores) | Scraping only, no API |
| Europe: Germany and rest of EU | F70, G60, G70 | Some (Motor-Talk, ADAC, KBA, app stores) | German and other languages |
| China | G68, G70 | App Store China storefront, English proxies | No direct owner voice without hard scraping |

---

## 5. Record format for everything we fetch

Every fetched item, from any source and any market, is stored in the same shape. This is what makes the audit trail and later weighting possible, so fix it **before** writing the first fetcher.

| Field | Example | Why it is needed |
|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | `reddit-1abc23-c4` | Unique key, stable across re-fetches |
| `source` | `reddit` | Source weighting later |
| `category` | `C` | Category from section 1 |
| `url` | permalink | Traceability to the original |
| `fetched_at` | `2026-10-10T16:02:00Z` | Audit trail |
| `published_at` | `2025-11-03` or empty | Trends over time; our BMW feedback has no dates |
| `author_hash` | hashed username | Count distinct people, not posts, without storing personal data |
| `brand`, `model`, `chassis_code`, `model_year` | `BMW`, `5 Series`, `G60`, `2024` | Separate current car from predecessor and competitors |
| `powertrain` | `ICE` / `PHEV` / `BEV` / unknown | Matches the feedback files |
| `market` | `US` or `unknown` | Market is a first-class filter |
| `language` | `en` | Translation tracking |
| `text_original` | raw text | Evidence must be the original |
| `text_en` | translated text | Analysis in one language |
| `rating` | `4/5` or empty | Where the source has one |
| `engagement` | upvotes, likes, replies | Kept separate from mention count (reach is not relevance) |
| `content_type` | `owner` / `expert` / `press` / `news` / `stat` | Owner voice vs marketing vs opinion |
| `raw_ref` | path to saved raw file | Re-processing without re-fetching |

Storage rule: save the **raw response first**, untouched, then normalize into this format in a second step.

---

## 6. Problems that will occur

### Access and legal

| Problem | Where it hits | How to avoid it |
|---|---|---|
| Anti-bot protection (Cloudflare, CAPTCHA) | Edmunds, KBB, Auto Trader, mobile.de, Autohome, Dongchedi | Start with API sources; scrape slowly with caching; drop the source if blocked rather than fighting it |
| Terms of use forbid scraping | Most review sites and forums | Check `robots.txt` and terms per source; record the check in the source config; keep volumes small |
| API quotas | YouTube Data API (daily unit budget, search is expensive), Reddit (rate limit, about 1,000 results per listing) | Cache everything; fetch by known video or thread ID instead of repeated searches |
| Unofficial libraries break | YouTube transcripts, Google Trends, app store scrapers | Treat as optional enrichment, never as a dependency of the demo |
| Cloud IPs get blocked | YouTube transcripts, some forums | Fetch from a laptop, store results, demo from stored data |
| Login or paywall | Facebook groups, Consumer Reports, parts of auto motor und sport | Skip; use free press summaries |
| Personal data (GDPR) | Usernames, profile links everywhere | Hash author names, never store profiles, keep only the text and metadata |

### Data quality

| Problem | Where it hits | How to avoid it |
|---|---|---|
| Wrong generation matched | "5 Series" returns G30 and older cars | Require chassis code or model year; tag predecessor explicitly instead of discarding it |
| Market unknown | Reddit, YouTube, forums have no country field | Store `unknown`; infer only from subreddit, language or site domain, and mark it as inferred |
| Duplicates and cross-posts | Same complaint on Reddit and Bimmerpost; one user posting ten times | Deduplicate on text similarity; count distinct `author_hash` |
| Reach mistaken for relevance | One viral video with 50,000 comments | Keep `engagement` separate; cap the contribution of a single thread or video |
| Sarcasm, jokes, brand-war comments | Reddit, YouTube comments | Classify owner vs non-owner; drop items without a concrete feature or problem |
| Marketing text mixed with customer voice | Press portals, sponsored reviews | `content_type` field; never count press text as a customer signal |
| Different rating scales | 5-star, 10-point, percentage shares | Keep the original scale and value; normalize in a separate field |
| Missing dates | Some review sites | Leave empty, never guess |
| Out-of-scope content | Recalls, pricing complaints, dealer service complaints | Filter against the challenge scope after classification |
| Translation errors | Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish sources | Keep `text_original` next to `text_en`; quote the original as evidence |

### Technical

| Problem | Where it hits | How to avoid it |
|---|---|---|
| JavaScript-rendered pages | Configurators, Chinese OEM sites, KBB | Look for the underlying JSON request first; headless browser only as last resort |
| Layout changes break scrapers | Any scraped site | One small parser per source; fail loudly with the URL logged |
| Text encoding | Chinese characters, German umlauts, French and Spanish accents | Read and write UTF-8 explicitly everywhere |
| Messy PDF tables | Competitor price lists | Extract text per page, let the model structure it, keep page number as source |
| Volume explosion | YouTube comments, Reddit | Set a cap per model per source up front |
| Lost traceability | Any source, if raw data is not kept | Raw-first storage rule from section 5 |

---

## 7. Recommended fetching order

Ordered so that each step works on its own, and a failure in a later step never blocks the demo.

| Step | What | Sources | Why at this point |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0** | Setup | Model and competitor config (section 2), record format (section 5), raw storage folder, cache | Changing the schema after fetching means refetching everything |
| **1** | Structured APIs | NHTSA complaints, Reddit, YouTube comments | Official access, no blocking, dated records, covers the US where G60 and G70 feedback is concentrated |
| **2** | News and press feeds | Car news RSS, CarNewsChina, CnEVPost, OEM press portals | Easy, gives competitor releases and the China view in English |
| **3** | App store reviews | Google Play and App Store for My BMW and rival apps | Easy, dated, per country, directly comparable across brands |
| **4** | BMW and competitor forums | Bimmerpost, MBWorld, AudiWorld, Tesla Motors Club, Motor-Talk | Deepest problem detail; scraping, so only after the pipeline is proven |
| **5** | Owner review sites | Parkers, Cars.com, What Car?, then Edmunds and KBB if not blocked | Adds ratings and the UK market for the F70 |
| **6** | Expert reviews | YouTube transcripts, Car and Driver, Autocar, comparison tests | Competition arguments; transcripts are fragile, so not earlier |
| **7** | Equipment comparison | Competitor price and option lists | Needed for the equipment-gap check against our option-list PDFs; manual effort per model |
| **8** | Market and trend data | KBA, SMMT, ACEA, Google Trends, consulting reports | Small volume, mostly manual download, used for weighting and assumptions |
| **9** | Native Chinese and other EU-language owner sources | Autohome, Dongchedi, 12365auto, Yiche, Caradisiac, Quattroruote, km77 | Highest effort and failure risk; only if time remains |

Market reached by each step: steps 1 to 3 are the **shared platforms plus USA**, with China through English news and the App Store China storefront. Step 5 adds the **UK**. Steps 4, 6 and 8 add **Germany**. Native **China** owner voice only arrives in step 9. See [section 4](#4-sources-by-market) for the full per-market list.

Assign the market to each shared-platform record (rules in [section 4.1](#41-shared-platforms-one-fetch-several-markets)) during normalization, right after fetching, so every later step can filter by market.

Rules that keep this safe:

1. Finish one source end to end (fetch, store raw, normalize) before starting the next.
2. Run each step for **one vehicle in one market first** (suggested: G60 in the US, the best-covered combination), then widen to the other six combinations from section 2.
3. Fetch once, cache, and run the demo from stored data, never live.
4. After steps 1 to 3 you already have complaints, wishes and competition. Everything after is enrichment.

---

## 8. Sources to skip

| Source | Reason |
|---|---|
| X (Twitter) | Paid API, short low-detail posts |
| TikTok, Instagram | No usable API, mostly visual content |
| Facebook groups | Login required, private data |
| Consumer Reports full data, JATO, MarkLines | Paid; use their free press releases |
| Trustpilot, Google Maps dealer reviews | About dealers and service, not the product |

Parked because the market is out of scope for now (add back when the scope widens):

| Market | Sources |
|---|---|
| Japan | Minkara, Kakaku.com |
| South Korea | Bobaedream, Naver cafés |
| Middle East | YallaMotor, DubiCars, ArabGT |
| India | Team-BHP, CarWale, CarDekho |
| Australia, Canada | ProductReview.com.au, Transport Canada |

---

## 9. Open points

- **Bias per source:** who posts there, which markets and owner types are over-represented. To be discussed.
- **Importance per source:** how much weight each source gets in prioritization. To be discussed.
- **Demo vehicle and market:** decides which sources in steps 5 and 9 are worth the effort.
- **China:** real Chinese owner platforms are in step 9; until then China is covered only through English-language news.
